physicalModel: Kacharov density shapes; Rathore offset bar; Pietrzynski distance; Choi plane; Oden warp; Nidever outskirts; VMC age budget; native SMASH stars; Bell internal dust; DeMCELS H-alpha.
modelingChoice: Kacharov density shapes with Rathore placement and Choi/Oden geometry; the original equilibrium solution is not retained.
assumptions: The bar Fourier center proxies its untabulated ellipse center. Offset direction is digitized from Figure 8 and is approximate at about 0.1 kpc, not the scalar measurement precision.
The warp uses a qualified 64 by 64 TAN cache, not the full native Oden release.
Gaussian heights are conditional widths; Ripepi provides a different-tracer comparison, not their direct measurement.
The outer count-to-light conversion assumes equal mass-to-light ratio.
Dust tint is a global appearance response, not a recovered grain extinction curve.

calibration.emission: Four component RGB coefficient triples in [0,100], equivalent to gain plus mean-normalized tint. Outskirts are tied to the old disc.
calibration.dust: Fixed Bell spatial columns; strength in [0.25,2], red/blue attenuation ratios in [0.6,1.5], green fixed to one.
calibration.display: One luminance asinh stretch [0,20] and saturation [0.5,2.5].
calibration.method: Bounded global coordinate search with weighted nonnegative least squares, then direct display-curve coordinate polish.
calibration.rungs: 64 and 128 pixel fits; 512 pixel renders at fixed fitted settings. No full fit.

sources: BC03 Z=0.008 Chabrier optical spectra, fixed proxy for VMC Kroupa population colors
SMASH blue observed-color count positions; strict fraction >=0.8; no photograph-derived values
Oden release: qualified Astropy TAN cache, 64 by 64, 0.25 degree pixels
limitations: BC03 and VMC use different IMFs/tracks; luminosity conversion is a fixed proxy with global normalization, not a claimed reproduction of VMC synthesis.
Oden cache covers less than the full native Galactic CAR release. Outside support the warp is unknown; a planar continuation with one-degree coverage taper is assumed.
Bell missing cells stay unsupported; no dust column is invented in gaps.
Warp is applied only beyond 4.5 kpc with a two-kpc smooth transition, preserving the accepted inner plane.

nativeStars.selection: 12 <= g,r,i < 20.5; -0.5 <= g-i < 0.5; measured errors <0.1 mag; strict PSF quality; smooth presentation taper 8.5–9 kpc. VMC polygons do not clip astrometry.
nativeStars.resolution: Individual measured positions; pixel integration only, no smoothing by survey regions
nativeStars.depth: Deterministic normal draws by source identifier, sigma equal to the adopted stellar height; each position remains on its measured Earth ray
nativeStars.luminosity: Observed gri photometry corrected with the declared dust-height prior, then one common normalization to the VMC young luminosity budget
limitations: Blue observed-color candidates, not a complete young-age or membership catalogue.
Distances are conditional; no individual stellar depth is claimed.
The bright selection excludes faint stars; the global population normalization accounts for unresolved light only in aggregate.
The VMC-derived young fraction is extrapolated outside VMC polygons wherever native SMASH astrometry is used. Nine kpc is a presentation limit, not a measured galaxy edge.

gas.meaning: Measured continuum-subtracted H-alpha-filter morphology, normalized once; one global RGB tint/gain supplies appearance color. Not a resolved spectral model.
gas.unsupported: Outside these qualified cutouts the ionized-gas component is not supplied, not measured absent.

sources.nativePopulation: The VMC age-derived young fraction is global. Native SMASH astrometry supplies its spatial distribution, without clipping to VMC region polygons. This extrapolates the age budget outside VMC coverage.
sources.gasDepth: DeMCELS samples are lifted along their measured Earth rays through the conditional thin layer. This preserves their known angular structure; individual depths are not measured.
